heard: A hacker stole $600 million, then he gave it back.
said: A hacker stole six hundred million dollars. Then he gave it back.

heard: and the company offered him a job.
said: And the company offered him a job.

heard: August 2021, Poly Network moved crypto between blockchains.
said: August twenty twenty-one. Poly Network moved crypto between blockchains.

heard: One bug in its code, let a hacker move the money to his own wallets.
said: One bug in its code let a hacker move the money to his own wallets.

heard: Over $610 million, the biggest DeFi hack at the time.
said: Over six hundred ten million dollars. The biggest Dee-fye hack at the time.
Tether froze thirty-three million of it.

heard: Then the hacker started sending it back.
said: Then the hacker started sending it back.

heard: In a message inside a transaction, he called it his effort to help their security.
said: In a message inside a transaction, he called it his effort to help their security.

heard: Poly Network nicknamed him Mr. White Hat.
said: Poly Network nicknamed him Mister White Hat.
They offered him a five hundred thousand dollar bounty.

heard: and a job, Chief Security Advisor.
said: And a job: Chief Security Advisor.

heard: Over 200 million stayed locked. It needed his key and theirs.
said: Over two hundred million stayed locked. It needed his key and theirs.

heard: On August 23rd, he handed over the final key.
said: On August twenty-third, he handed over the final key.
